summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the pricing of a $750 million private offering of senior notes due 2031 with a 5.625% coupon, reduced to ~4.500% after cross-currency swaps. Proceeds will repay revolving credit facility draws to fund a portion of the previously announced SECURE Waste Infrastructure acquisition. The offering is leverage-neutral. This is a routine debt placement, not a special situation. No change of control, activist, or strategic event is triggered.
